summary.text: Brian Collamore is the incumbent state senator for the Rutland District and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot seeking re-election as a Republican and Democratic candidate.
He has served in the Senate since January 2015 and chairs the Senate Government Operations Committee.

paragraphs.text: Collamore took office in the Vermont State Senate on January 7, 2015.
His 2025-2026 committee assignments are the Agriculture Committee, the Senate Government Operations Committee, which he chairs, and the Senate Rules Committee.
